features.title: Subagent model routes follow the saved setting in running threads
features.summary: The forked subagent and subagent_fork tools keep upstream's schema and delegation behaviour, but the allowed child model routes are re-read from the Subagents model-selection setting at each delegation or list_subagent_models call. A changed list appends a replacement subagent/model-selection-policy event, and the policy projection keeps the latest one, so a route added after a thread started is accepted without a new thread.
failureModes: A profile whose preset-standard delegation rows still name @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent keeps the frozen per-Session route list.
A thread that started with model selection off keeps a tool without provider/model fields until a new thread; turning the setting off mid-thread keeps the last recorded routes.
